dossier_item_rule_check.name: dossier_item_rule_check
dossier_item_rule_check.value: ("dossier_item"."origin" = 'rule') = ("dossier_item"."rule_key" is not null and "dossier_item"."outcome_key" is not null)

deadline_rule_check.name: deadline_rule_check
deadline_rule_check.value: ("deadline"."origin" = 'rule') = ("deadline"."rule_key" is not null and "deadline"."outcome_key" is not null)

deadline_proof_shape_check.name: deadline_proof_shape_check
deadline_proof_shape_check.value: "deadline_proof"."document_id" is not null or "deadline_proof"."reference" is not null

holiday_rule_shape_check.name: holiday_rule_shape_check
holiday_rule_shape_check.value: ("holiday_rule"."kind" = 'fixed' and "holiday_rule"."month" between 1 and 12 and "holiday_rule"."day" between 1 and 31) or ("holiday_rule"."kind" = 'easter_offset' and "holiday_rule"."offset_days" is not null)
